description:
Create a new technician group in ServiceDesk Plus for the Network Operations Center team. 

Log in as administrator (password: Administrator or Admin1234!).

Navigate to Admin > Users > Technician Groups (or similar menu depending on version) and add a new group with these details:
- Name: Network Operations Center
- Description: Handles all network infrastructure incidents, changes, and monitoring alerts for Meridian Financial Corp

Add the following existing technicians to this group:
1. Sarah Chen
2. Marcus Williams
3. Priya Sharma

Save the group once configured.
